decisions.reason: The air fin cooler is core to the portfolio, the firm is growing with slack, and nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
The condenser fits the established offer, and its overlap with C leaves only a modest consolidation risk while performance appears satisfactory.
As the near-duplicate of B it is the likelier candidate for rationalisation, but in an expanding firm with no visible shortfall there is little pressure to cut it.
The tube liner supports the strategic lifecycle-service business at low cost and likely meets aspirations.
The customized air cooler line embodies the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and spreads risk across several models.
The tube end repair inserts add aftermarket revenue with little resource use, so the firm has no reason to drop them while it expands.
